scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter "@vizij/utils" run build && pnpm --filter "@vizij/render" run build && pnpm --filter "@vizij/animation-react" run build && pnpm --filter "@vizij/node-graph-react" run build && pnpm --filter "@vizij/orchestrator-react" run build
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter demo-animation-studio run build && pnpm --filter demo-graph-studio run build && pnpm --filter vizij-authoring run build && pnpm --filter demo-vizij-player run build && pnpm --filter minimal-demo-animation run build && pnpm --filter minimal-demo-animation-graph run build && pnpm --filter minimal-demo-graph run build && pnpm --filter minimal-demo-orchestrator run build
scripts.prep: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck:all
scripts.prep:push: pnpm run format && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck:all && pnpm run test
scripts.reset:hard: pnpm -r run --if-present reset:hard && rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.release: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build:packages && changeset publish
